4000_2022.selection_event: Inward RITC. p24: 'The syndicate accepted a reinsurance to close of Syndicate 3334 effective 1 January 2022'; p5: 'On the closure of its 2019 year of account, Syndicate 3334 was reinsured to close into Syndicate 4000, with an effective date of 1 January 2022 ... transferred to Syndicate 4000's 2020 underwriting year of account'. It falls at the opening of year t = 2022 (so before both year-2022 movements) and touches 3334's cohorts 2015-2019, all inside u<=2020. The roll-forward p37 shows it as its own line: gross claims outstanding 374,414 + movement 131,911 + 'RITC of Syndicate 3334' 181,247 + FX 51,235 = 738,807.
4000_2022.overlap: Yes, by design: this table is an acquired book shown 'as if always'. p5: 'results for the year ended 31 December 2022 comprise Syndicate 4000's pure underwriting years of 2020 to 2022 (open years), 2019 (closed year) and Syndicate 3334's closed years of 2015 to 2019'. Evidence in the cells: the 2021 report's table (4000 only) started at 2019 with 2019 at end-2021 = 198,065; the 2022 table's end-2021 cell for 2019 is 296,211 (x1.50), whereas 2020 (233,141 -> 255,280, x1.095) and 2021 (97,355 -> 106,814, x1.097) move by currency only. Columns 2015-2018 did not exist in the 2021 report because 4000's own 2018-and-prior went to Syndicate 3500 on 1 January 2021. So the end-2021 base in this table is the combined 4000+3334 book, restated on the same basis as end-2022; M therefore measures the combined portfolio's movement for u<=2020 (2015-2018 pure 3334: 13,012 of M; 2019 mixed: 12,767; 2020 pure 4000: 3,751). The 2019 column cannot be split into 4000 own and 3334 own from this page.
4000_2022.gross_net: Gross table; net development printed separately. Reinsurers' share of the take-on is its own line (119,821, p37). No net figure in a gross row seen; table outstanding 738,807 = balance sheet 738,807 (p37).

The +3.2% excess has the sign and scale of the closing-versus-average rate effect on a USD-heavy book (p32: US premium 189,203 of 454,195); the rates are not on the page read.

4000_2022.reconstruction: Validated for the combined portfolio, not separable for 4000-original cohorts. The take-on is a visible gross line (181,247), the restated base ties incurred to the accounts within 3.2%, and the combined opening (555,661) is the right R for the combined M. The pure 4000 part of the 2019 column is not printed for end-2022.
4000_2022.reason: The inward RITC of Syndicate 3334 (effective 1 January 2022) is folded into the table as if always for 2015-2019, so M is a combined-book movement and the 2019 column mixes two vehicles. Both diagonals are on the same combined basis, the take-on is a separate 181.2m gross line in the roll-forward and implied incurred then ties to the accounts (288.3 v 279.3, +3.2%), so M is valid for the combined book with R including the take-on. A 4000-only M cannot be isolated for 2019.
